title: Recording: Looking Over From My Hotel Window by Yoko Ono | 1972
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono

The final recording session for Yoko Ono‘s third album Approximately Infinite Universe took place on 26 November 1972, with John Lennon co-producing.

The song worked on was ‘Looking Over From My Hotel Window’, which had been started the previous day. It was mixed on 27 and 28 November.
